description.value: Go To Shop is a small department/general store located in Logan Lake, a compact mining and ranching community in BC's Nicola Valley. OSM records it as a department store with limited hours, suggesting it serves as a general-purpose shop for local residents. For a touring cyclist, it appears to be the kind of catch-all community store that may stock a range of basic goods in an otherwise remote stretch of the Thompson Highlands.
